thread:
maria: Morning — quick ops-gate sync for the operability criteria before GA. Need green checks for: SLA doc, runbooks/playbooks, 24/7 escalation coverage, monitoring + dashboards, and a pricing backstop. Who can confirm status?
ajay: I'm on the SLA wording. Draft PR at https://git.redwood/sla/pr123 — covers uptime, latency p95, and credit calc. Waiting legal sign-off. ETA EOD Wed.
sam: Docs owner here — runbook + playbooks live in docs repo. One missing play: model-output-regression (we need steps for bad hallucination). I'll add a minimal playbook tonight.
jordan: Oncall rota — we have pilot coverage but weekend backup is missing. Can we borrow an extra eng-sre for GA weekends? @sam can you own the handoff docs for that backup?
ajay: Monitoring checklist: set availability alert at 99.9% infra-level; latency p95 alert at 250ms for gen-1 models. Page on token-error spike (3x baseline) and on automatic fallback failures. Dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/operability/ga
maria: Pricing question — if we exceed forecast by 3x, what's the short-term plan to protect unit economics? Need a written backstop (cap + escalation + invoicing behavior). @finops-bot?
finops-bot: Draft pricing backstop options: (1) temporary usage cap with automated email + exec alert, (2) invoice hold + manual review for extreme overages, (3) quick add-on seat pricing for burst. Will post contract language snippet by Thu.
sam: Quick runbook snippet I'll add to docs:
```
steps:
- detect anomaly (errors/latency)
- switch to compatible fallback model
- notify service-oncall and support channel
- escalate to eng-sre if fallback fails
- open postmortem template
```
ops-bot: Dry-run executed at 3509800000 — fallback flow exercised, metrics emitted, no pager. Coverage validated for weekday scenario. :white_check_mark:
jordan: Escalation matrix proposal: support -> service-oncall -> eng-sre -> platform pager. Need support to have SLA-credit request flow documented (who signs, timeline).
maria: Consolidating action items: 
- ajay: push SLA PR + highlight credit calc (EOD Wed)
- sam: add model-failure playbook + weekend coverage note (tomorrow)
- jordan: secure weekend backup from eng-sre (today)
- finops-bot: sample pricing backstop language (Thu)
- ops-bot: run another dry-run after weekend change (Mon)
I'll gather evidence for the launch bundle once these are green.
ajay: One open risk: Dedicated customers expect stricter latency SLOs. Proposing a tiered SLA appendix rather than blocking GA. Raising as exception.
maria: Good call — we'll include a tiered SLA appendix in the PR. If all items above are green, we can clear the operability gate. Otherwise this stays blocking. :triage:
